headline: BI Records First Semester 2026 QRIS Transactions Reaching 12.55 Billion, Value Exceeds Rp 600 Trillion
summary: Bank Indonesia recorded 12.55 billion transactions through the QRIS quick response code payment standard across the country in the first half of 2026. The transaction value exceeded Rp 600 trillion.
why: QRIS is Indonesia's national QR payment standard run by the central bank. Growth in digital payment volumes signals changes in consumer payments and the fintech sector.
